app.name: Family Expense Tracker
app.loadError: The app could not open its database.

lock.title: Locked
lock.lockedOut: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {{s}} s.
lock.forgotHelp: For security the PIN cannot be recovered. Delete the app, install it again and choose “Join an existing family”: the data comes back from Dropbox.

onboarding.newFamilyHint: First phone: set up parents, children, PIN and budget.
onboarding.joinFamilyHint: Second phone: connect Dropbox and bring in the data.
onboarding.parentNameHint: The name appears under “Paid by” and in the analytics.
onboarding.ownerHint: Pre-selected as “Paid by” for expenses entered on this phone.
onboarding.childrenCountHint: How many children the family has.
onboarding.childNameHint: The name appears under “For whom” and in the analytics.
onboarding.birthYearHint: The birth year determines which age-appropriate expense categories are offered.
onboarding.pinHint: This unlocks the app on this phone. Don't tell the children.
onboarding.pinMismatch: The PINs don't match. Try again.
onboarding.biometricsHint: Unlock with the phone's passkey. The PIN always works as a fallback.
onboarding.biometricsUnsupported: Not supported on this device or browser.
onboarding.budgetHint: Total monthly spending limit. Alerts at 80% and 100%.
onboarding.joinLater: Available once Dropbox sync is added (Phase 4).

dashboard.empty: No expenses yet. Tap + to add one.
dashboard.budgetCardHint: Tap to change the budget for this month or for all months.
dashboard.swipeHint: Swipe left to delete, tap to edit.

expense.recentHint: The subcategories you used last — one tap.
expense.categoryHint: Pick a category, then a subcategory.
expense.forWhomHint: Which family member the expense was for.
expense.noteHint: Optional short note, up to 60 characters.

settings.languageHint: Display language of the app on this phone.
settings.themeHint: Light, dark, or follow the phone's setting.
settings.versionHint: Version of the app running on this phone.
settings.categoriesCountHint: Number of categories and subcategories stored locally.
settings.deviceIdHint: This phone's unique id used for syncing.
settings.changePinHint: Changes the PIN on this phone only.
settings.biometricsHint: Unlock with the phone's passkey. The PIN always works as a fallback.
settings.biometricsUnsupported: Not supported on this device or browser.

budget.title: Budget
budget.amountHint: Monthly spending limit. Alerts at 80% and 100%.
budget.scopeHint: Only the selected month, or as the default for every month without its own amount.
budget.noneHint: Removes the limit for the “Applies to” choice.
budget.resetHint: Removes this month's own amount; the default applies again.

sync.intro: Both phones share expenses through the same Dropbox account. Everything is encrypted on the phone before upload.
sync.step1: Tap “Open Dropbox” and sign in (the same account on both phones).
sync.step3: Copy the code shown and paste it here.
sync.openDropboxHint: Opens Dropbox's authorization page in a new tab.
sync.codeRejected: The code was not accepted. Open Dropbox again for a new code.
sync.passIntroCreate: It encrypts the data in Dropbox. You will type it once on the second phone too.
sync.passIntroJoin: Type the family passphrase set on the first phone.
sync.passHint: At least 8 characters. Keep it somewhere safe: without it the Dropbox data cannot be opened.
sync.noFamily: No family found in this Dropbox. On the first phone choose “New family”, then connect Dropbox in Settings.
sync.familyExists: A family already exists in this Dropbox — type its passphrase.
sync.autoSyncHint: Syncs a few seconds after each change, when the app opens and every minute while it is open.
sync.errOffline: No internet connection — changes will be sent later.
sync.errAuth: The Dropbox connection expired. Connect again.
sync.errKey: The Dropbox data can't be opened with this phone's passphrase.
sync.errOther: Sync failed. It will retry automatically.
sync.disconnectHint: Stops syncing on this phone. The phone's data stays.
sync.merged_one: {{count}} change arrived from the other phone
sync.merged_other: {{count}} changes arrived from the other phone
sync.statusHint: Sync status with the other phone.

join.title: Join a family
join.whoHint: Pre-selected as “Paid by” for this phone's expenses.
join.noParents: No family members found in Dropbox. Make sure the first phone has synced.

family.nameHint: The name appears on expenses and in the analytics. Saved automatically.
family.removeChildHint: Removes the child from the choices. Past expenses keep the name.
family.ownerHint: Pre-selected as “Paid by” for this phone's expenses.
family.defaultBudgetHint: Applies to every month without its own amount. A single month's amount is changed from the card on Home.
